query: Audit accessibility across every page in https://www.facilitron.com/sitemap.xml and group the WCAG violations.
expected_behavior: Recognizes the sitemap target as a many-page scan and selects the pa11y-ci breadth path over single-URL axe
Delegates the run to the a11y-scan-runner subagent via the Task tool rather than running the scanners itself
Asks the runner to return findings grouped by issue type with severity counts
Relays the runner's report and keeps the automated-coverage caveat that a clean scan is not full compliance
